questions.question_en: What is the main limitation of choosing a crop from a national soil-colour map alone?
questions.question_te: National soil-colour map ఒక్కటితో crop selectionలో లోపం?
options: Every soil boundary is a farm boundary
Climate has no role
All farms in one colour have identical yields
It ignores local depth, drainage, water and nutrient constraints
option_explanations: Map units generalise.
Climate is essential.
Management and site variation affect yields.
Farm suitability requires finer-scale evidence and several controls.
